messages:
maya: quick question — can we support on-demand checkpoint probing for safetensors shards without a manifest?
ranjit: do you mean probing file headers to build a runtime manifest at load time? we had that idea in the loader rfc
sasha: yep. probe headers + compute shard offsets, then write an ephemeral index in memory. avoids forcing a build step.
maya: pros: faster onboarding for new model uploads, no build artifact. cons: extra syscalls and seeks during cold-start
tess: what about network-backed filesystems? probing could add a 100-300ms stall if across remote object storage
ranjit: we can parallelize header probes across threadpool + sticky IO workers. also cache the ephemeral index in shared mem for the process
oliver: thinking about interface: WeightSource should expose `scan_headers()` which returns list of (tensor_path, offset, length, dtype)
maya: sketch:
```
let index = source.scan_headers().await?;
let shard_plan = layout.assign(index, placement_policy);
```
sasha: error handling: if probe fails for some shards, fallback to streaming-per-tensor reads instead of full failure
infra-bot: deploy-check: please add unit test for probing failure -> streaming fallback (ci test matrix: local fs, s3, nfs)
ranjit: warmup path tradeoff: eager warmup builds kv cache but increases memory. maybe default to on-demand + background hotstart
tess: +1 on background hotstart. trigger only for critical tensors (embeddings, attention) based on model profile
maya: how do we detect critical tensors? profiler during first few inferences or offline eval profile
oliver: we already have profile heuristics in optimize; reuse those signals (token distribution, seq len)
sasha: one more: atomic swap of ephemeral index to avoid races when multiple processes probe same model dir
maya: good call. use .index.tmp + rename op which is atomic on POSIX
deployment-bot: note: rename on S3 is not atomic; must write to manifest service or use object metadata tagging
ranjit: then manifest-service fallback for remote stores. local fast-path uses ephemeral index files
maya: plan of action: 1) add scan_headers API 2) implement parallel probes with timeout 3) background hotstart for critical tensors 4) tests for fs types
tess: i'll own test matrix. ranjit will prototype scan_headers. sasha + oliver to review API
maya: thanks everyone — will follow up with a short RFC patch and perf numbers from prototype :thumbsup:
